name: Athena Search
author: Syncit Group

sections.description:
Athena Search enhances product discovery with AI-powered search features. It integrates Visual Search, Voice Search, and Semantic Search, delivering fast, relevant, and accurate results for products and content.

Athena Search is compatible with WooCommerce and WordPress, enabling automatic indexing of products, categories, and product attributes. The plugin includes advanced autocomplete, merchandising tools, and customizable UX/UI options.

After contract signing, clients receive secure access credentials required for integration, including access to the Athena dashboard, website token, integration key, client ID, and client secret. These credentials enable full configuration, monitoring, and management of Athena Search services.

Key Features

  • AI Visual Search – search by image upload or photo
  • AI Voice Search – natural language product search
  • AI Semantic Search – understands search intent
  • WooCommerce and WordPress integration
  • Automatic indexing of products, categories, attributes, posts, and authors
  • Advanced autocomplete and merchandising features: Synonyms, Keyword redirects, Banners, Product promotion, First-click suggestions, Stop words, Long-tail search support
  • Customizable search experience
  • Detailed analytics and reports (usage trends, search KPIs)
  • Fast, reliable performance

Technical Details

  • Free lifetime updates
  • Last updated: 16 January 2026

Support

For setup assistance or pricing details, visit:
https://a-x.ai/get-a-demo/ or contact us at sales@a-x.ai
sections.installation:
You can install Athena Search in three ways:

  1. From WordPress Admin (Recommended)

    • Go to Plugins → Add New
    • Search for “Athena Search”
    • Click Install Now
    • Click Activate

  2. From the WordPress Plugin Directory

    • Download the plugin from: https://wordpress.org/plugins/athena-search/
    • Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
    • Activate via Plugins → Installed Plugins

  3. Manual ZIP Installation

    • Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
    • Choose the ZIP file
    • Click Install Now and Activate
sections.faq:
Will it work with my theme?

Yes. Athena Search can be customized to work with any WordPress theme.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes. Athena Search supports WooCommerce. Products and product details are automatically indexed.

Does Athena Search use AI?

Yes. Athena Search uses AI technologies to improve product search, recommendations, visual, voice, and semantic search, and more.

Are reports or analytics included?

Yes. You can view search usage, trends, and detailed KPIs.

Do I need to pay extra for Voice or Visual Search?

No. All AI search features are included, so your customers get the best possible experience.
